NewUI/icons/ is a subdirectory of the NewUI design system refactor root
Pencil/edit icon named ic-post directly corresponds to the post_status navigation destination where users compose status updates
Gear/cog icon named ic-settings is the standard settings symbol; maps to the settings navigation destination
Clock icon named ic-timeline represents time-based views; history screen renders a timeline list of past statuses
Paper-plane send icon is the standard submit/publish affordance within the post_status flow
Trash icon may delete individual history entries; could also be for unpairing or clearing status — exact target needs UI review
Sunburst/8-ray radiate pattern visually resembles the particle burst animation in CelebrationOverlay (CelebrationOverlay.kt renders full-screen particle effects)
Sparkle icon named ic-sparkle represents celebration/highlight moments; CelebrationOverlay triggers on configured MM/dd dates once per day
Sun icon may represent Feeling.开心 (happy/sunny mood) in the FeelingPicker component; could also be a generic weather/mood indicator — needs UI mockup confirmation
Signal bars represent connectivity/paired-device status; home screen displays partner's status via polling and pairing state
Signal strength icon may indicate pairing connection health; devices pair via 6-char code exchange tracked in pairs table
Signal bars may visualize polling/live-connection status; HomeViewModel polls Supabase every 6s via callbackFlow
Ruler icon may relate to measuring/constraining custom Doing text input (capped at 20 characters); alternatively a design/layout tool — purpose unclear from icon alone
If ruler represents the custom Doing text constraint, it belongs to post_status where Doing is selected; very low confidence — review needed
Sun icon likely decorates the home screen mood display or FeelingPicker; home screen shows current feeling and status on StatusCard
